Vendored browser dependencies (no CDN requests in production):
- SheetJS Community Edition 0.20.3, Apache-2.0: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.full.min.js
- pdfmake 0.2.20, MIT: https://github.com/bpampuch/pdfmake
- Roboto fonts included in pdfmake vfs, Apache-2.0.
Upstream license banners are preserved in files. Inputs are parsed locally in the browser; only the confirmed normalized records are sent to the application's authenticated API.
